name: QueryMap
description: Calls the given closure with every row in the query.
syntax: QueryMap( query query, function closure, [query resQuery], [boolean parallel], [number maxThreads] )

params.name: closure
params.description:
filter can be a function/closure that implements the following constructor

`function(struct row[, number rowNumber, query query]):struct`.

The returned struct is used to fill a single query row.

params.name: maxThreads
params.description: maximum number of threads executed, ignored when argument "parallel" is set to false
